request: Add "h5py>=3.10" to the extra-ayan list (or to dependencies).
reason: h5netcdf>=1.3 does not pull in an HDF5 backend; without h5py (or pyfive) analogforge.adapters.emit cannot read or the replay tests write EMIT-style NetCDF. In the shared .venv it was installed with `uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python h5py` (h5py 3.16.0).
workaround: none inside owned paths; tests/replay/science/test_adapters.py::TestEmit fail with ImportError on a venv built from the current pyproject.
